## Compatibility and risk

Identify changes to public API, CLI, schemas, manifests, generated artifacts,
repository/curriculum compatibility, plugin contracts, supported platforms,
licensing/provenance, privacy, security, accessibility, learner safety, or
architecture. State the contract maturity, migration, and rollback. Use `None`
only after checking each surface.

## Documentation and release

List changed user/developer/governance documents and the intended release note
or explain why neither is required.

## Checklist

- [ ] Generated files, caches, credentials, and unlicensed source material are
      not included
- [ ] New behavior has tests

- [ ] Significant public-contract, authority, or data-flow changes have an
      accepted RFC and ADR as applicable
